jobs.title: HR People Associate - Working Student
jobs.description: En bref En tant que HR People Associate chez Picnic, tu prendras en charge l’administration RH du quotidien pour nos équipes à Paris. En lien direct avec notre People Partner France, tu veilleras à ce que chaque étape administrative soit réalisée dans les temps : de la préparation de l’arrivée d’un nouveau collègue au suivi de son contrat, en passant par les demandes RH du quotidien. Tu seras responsable du suivi de tes propres sujets, de la collecte des documents aux dernières relances, en veillant à ce que rien ne passe entre les mailles du filet. Une fois ces responsabilités bien maîtrisées, tu pourras élargir ton périmètre à certaines activités administratives de nos équipes People aux Pays-Bas et en Allemagne. Tes missions Gérer l’administration de l’onboarding : collecter les documents nécessaires, coordonner les étapes administratives et t’assurer que tout est prêt pour le premier jour de chaque nouvelle recrue. Assurer le suivi des documents RH : préparer les contrats, avenants, attestations et courriers à partir de nos modèles, coordonner leur validation et leur signature, puis veiller à leur bon classement. Garantir la fiabilité des dossiers RH : tenir les données et les outils à jour, suivre les échéances et relancer les interlocuteurs concernés jusqu’à la résolution de chaque sujet. Organiser le suivi de la médecine du travail : planifier les rendez-vous, gérer les convocations et veiller au respect des échéances administratives. Piloter le suivi administratif des véhicules de fonction (lease cars) : coordonner les échanges avec les prestataires, préparer les documents nécessaires et suivre les livraisons comme les restitutions. Être le premier point de contact pour les demandes RH courantes : apporter une réponse aux questions administratives, assurer le suivi des demandes et solliciter le People Partner lorsque la situation le nécessite. jobs.title: Manager, GTM Talent Acqusition
jobs.description: At ClickUp , we're building the future of work: the first truly converged AI workspace unifying tasks, docs, chat, calendar, and enterprise search, all supercharged by context-driven AI. We are an AI-native company. Every team member is expected to leverage AI daily, and we evaluate AI fluency as part of our hiring process. Join us and help redefine what's possible. Curious to see ClickUp Brain in action? Skip the JD below and check out the artifact here . ClickUp is redefining the future of work with AI and our TA team is at the center of that mission. We're evolving how we hire, building toward a future where AI takes on more of the heavy lifting so our recruiters can invest more deeply in what matters most: a genuinely human experience. There's lot of work to be done and we want someone excited to help us build this. We're betting that as we build more with AI, the human touch becomes increasingly important. That's why we want this leader based in New England to scale our Boston GTM hub with the kind of magic that only happens in person: hosting events, building talent community, and developing the relationships that make every GTM seller in Boston know our name before they're even looking. You're a player-coach who still loves the craft and is ready to multiply it. In this Manager, Talent Acquisition role you lead a pod of recruiters, carry your own req load of quota-carrying GTM roles, and own hiring for a major slice of our sales org across multiple hiring managers and regions all while building the future with AI. As a function we've been focused on thinking big, building small, shipping fast. We want YOU to lead from the front and accelerate that for your pod, measuring what ships, not how many agents you launched. The Role: Lead and coach your team. Run 1:1s, pipeline reviews, real-time feedback, own performance and career conversations, and set the bar on quality, speed, partnership, and candidate experience. Be a player coach. Carry your own load of quota

jobs.title: Senior Business Recruiter (12-Month Contract)
jobs.description: At Ripple, we’re building a world where value moves like information does today. It’s big, it’s bold, and we’re already doing it. Through our crypto solutions for financial institutions, businesses, governments and developers, we are improving the global financial system and creating greater economic fairness and opportunity for more people, in more places around the world. And we get to do the best work of our career and grow our skills surrounded by colleagues who have our backs.  If you’re ready to see your impact and unlock incredible career growth opportunities, join us, and build real world value. THE WORK: Are you a seasoned Business Recruiter looking for a chance to define an impact? Look no further! Ripple is seeking a Senior Business Recruiter to join our dynamic team and help us bring in top talent to drive our growth and innovation forward. As the Senior Business Recruiter, you will be a crucial part of the recruiting process, owning the process from start to finish and partnering closely with hiring managers to identify, attract and retain top talent. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work with a versatile team and play a key role in crafting the future of Ripple. You will work closely with our Talent Acquisition leader to build and implement a recruiting strategy that aligns with our strategic objectives while providing an outstanding candidate experience. Join us and be part of a company that is a leading provider of digital asset infrastructure for financial institutions WHAT YOU’LL DO: Own the recruiting process from sourcing to offers for multiple positions across the company. Develop strategies to meet hiring goals and work alongside hiring managers to align priorities and objectives Ensure great candidate experience keeping candidates advised and well-prepared throughout the entire process Partner with hiring managers to understand and meet their hiring needs Own and drive the intake meeting, interview team kick-off and debrief

jobs.description: Hi! I’m Rachel and I lead People Operations here at Ashby . I recently joined and I’m excited that we're expanding our team! The People Operations Team provides support to Ashby employees through the development and implementation of programs, policies, and services that contribute to a productive and inclusive working environment. We ensure that the work we do aligns with our Operating Principles and strengthens the environment we're building at Ashby. Our approach is to do things differently – we prioritize what truly fits our team and enhances how we work together. By embracing creativity and customization, we aim to create a people-first culture that drives both individual and organizational success. We review all applications, and there isn’t a benefit to applying quickly. Take your time, look at the application questions and please submit before the application deadline! We aren’t able to take calls outside of the interview process, so reaching out to the team won’t push your application forward. About the Role We’re looking for an experienced Total Rewards leader to build and own Ashby’s total rewards function through our next phase of growth. This is a builder’s role. Some of the foundation is in place; a lot of it isn’t. You’ll set the philosophy, design the frameworks, build the infrastructure, and run the work day to day. It’s a chance to shape how a company rewards its people rather than administer decisions someone else made. It’s also unusually analytical, and unusually creative. Ashby’s Total Rewards philosophy is principled and intentionally not one-size-fits-all: approaches vary by function, because different parts of the business compete in different talent markets. jobs.title: HR & People Lead (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Weltweit arbeiten rund 80 % der Beschäftigten nicht am Schreibtisch. Passende Software gibt es für sie bislang kaum. Mit Ordio 💙 ändern wir das: eine „all in one"-Plattform, die genau diese Menschen in den Fokus stellt und ihren Arbeitsalltag organisiert – von der Schichtplanung über die Zeiterfassung bis hin zu Payroll. 2026 haben wir eine Series-A-Finanzierung über 12 Mio. € erhalten und wachsen Markt für Markt über Deutschland hinaus 🚀 Mit unserem weiteren Wachstum professionalisieren wir unsere People-Funktion und suchen dafür unseren ersten HR & People Lead (m/w/d) . Wir suchen jemanden mit fundiertem HR-Background und echtem Builder-Operator-Mindset, der Lust hat, Dinge von Grund auf aufzubauen, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und unsere People & Culture-Arbeit bei Ordio aktiv zu gestalten. Du bist strategischer Sparringspartner für Management und Teamleads, entwickelst unsere Performance-Kultur weiter und nutzt KI, um smarte, effiziente und skalierbare HR-Prozesse aufzubauen. Gleichzeitig packst du operativ selbst mit an und verantwortest unsere HR-Themen von A bis Z – von Arbeitsrecht und Verträgen bis zur Unterstützung unserer internationalen Expansion. Join our HR team in De Lier and help us attract the people who will contribute to Priva’s future. As our new Corporate Recruiter, you will focus primarily on non-technical and commercial vacancies, including roles within account management, customer support, fulfillment and other business functions. You will have the freedom to take ownership of your recruitment portfolio while working closely with hiring managers, HR colleagues and other stakeholders across the organization. Climate for growth Priva develops innovative solutions for horticulture and building automation.
